coarseness: fewest modelled zones (zone_count) among the zonings with at most the reference's zone count; ties are all recommended; a cell where only finer zonings meet the threshold has none and finer_than_reference

threshold.basis: ASHRAE Guideline 14 hourly limits (CV(RMSE) 30 %, NMBE 10 %), annual error 10 %, conditioned area 1 %; proposed, the owner decides

deduplication.rule: the same zone-geometry signature (each zone's multiplier and floor polygons, vertices rounded to 1 mm, names left out) and the same annual ideal sensible heating and cooling within the relative energy tolerance
deduplication.kept: heat-transfer setting closest to the reference's (IWHT and FHT both on; IWHT on, FHT off; IWHT off, FHT on; both off), then simplifier by name, join pieces (unset, off, on), perimeter depth as a number, stacker by name; a reference is never dropped
